model.candidatePool: Current Winning in Style mainboard cards with an Oracle ID.
model.pairLift: log10((pair co-cubes * qualifying cubes) / (anchor cubes * candidate cubes))
model.confidence: Displayed score multiplies pair log lift by pair co-cubes / (pair co-cubes + 20).
model.groupScore: Weighted mean of confidence-adjusted pair log lift across selected anchors.
model.zeroHandling: Pairs with no shared qualifying cube contribute zero and remain visible through anchor coverage.
